source.publication: Michalkova et al 2023 Plant Systematics and Evolution
source.numerical_proxy: Inv_Sp = Ibr_W / Inv_W; not physical spine length

estimand: Within identical taxon and reproductive-sex strata, are there same-individual reproductive core size-compatible pairs whose relative external phyllary-tip spread differs? Descriptive feasibility, not selection.

matching.core_first: greedy across eligible edges ranked by scaled normalized core distance ascending; row id tie break; does not select on outer contrast
matching.outer_first: greedy across only outer-divergent eligible edges ranked by outer contrast descending; row id tie break
